snippet.title: Populous - PC - The First God Game (Bullfrog/EA 1989)
snippet.description:
Populous - Amiga. The first god game. You can wield your godly powers and read, watch, listen and play the history of EA at my video game history website The Dot Eaters: https://thedoteaters.com/?bitstory=computer/electronic-arts

Populous was a computer game masterpiece by designer Peter Molyneux and game developer Bullfrog, that set the stage for every God Game and real-time strategy game to follow.
